question: Why does Igarappoi go "ahem, maaa-maaa-maaa"? I'm so interested I can't sleep.
answer: "Maaa-maaa-maaa". It's the very first thing you practice when you take singing lessons. Maaa (→) Maaa (↗) Maaa (↑) Maaa (↗) Maa (→) So he does that singing thing when he speaks. His throat is strug...!! Ahem!! Ahem!! Maaa-maaa-maaa-maaa-maaa!
